rationale: The assistant identified the likely RCD trip, took the faint electrical smell seriously, gave clear stop-use triggers, and advised an electrician with a useful handover list. Weaknesses: it did not firmly advise isolating the hob until tested, instead allowing minimal use, and the second reply is long and repeats some earlier content. It also did not ask about boil-overs or whether two zones were on high, which would have helped with moisture ingress. It made no unsupported part claims.
